neighbours.label: the pivot to the remainder or the substitute once a part has been set aside: 'Most'/'the rest' after a stated minority, 'replace/replacing' (them with…) after things to drop
fire: Only a fifth of the town's waste is recycled. Most is buried in a landfill outside the valley.
Cut out fried snacks, replacing them with nuts or fresh fruit.
Just three of the paintings are originals. Most are copies made by students.
Three of the boats returned by noon; the rest stayed out until dark.
Take down the faded posters and replace them with the new season's schedule.
Barely a tenth of the letters were answered. Most were filed without a reply.
Remove the rusted bolts, replacing them with stainless steel ones.
One of the wells still gives clean water; the rest have run dry.
quiet: A fifth of the town's waste is recycled at a plant outside the valley.
Fried snacks, nuts and fresh fruit were laid out on the table.
Three of the paintings are originals bought from a dealer in Vienna.
Three of the boats returned by noon with a full catch of herring.
Take down the faded posters and fold them into the storage box.
A tenth of the letters were answered by the mayor in person.
The rusted bolts were holding up the old steel gate.
One of the wells still gives clean water throughout the summer.

notes: Card: ' Most' x3, ',' x3, ';' x2, ' replace', ' replacing'; output suppresses ' other', ' remaining', ' others', ' else' (so it fires where the complement set is about to be named). Probes: 'Only ten percent … fresh. Most' 0.79, 'replacing them with' 0.80, 'replace them with' 0.40, '; the rest' 0.42; sentence-initial 'Most apples' 0.01; no-contrast controls 0.01.
